item.title: From Raw Data to Insights: Introduction to Data Preprocessing
item.description: Data preprocessing is a crucial step in the machine learning pipeline. It involves cleaning, transforming, and preparing raw data to make it suitable for building and training machine learning models. In this hands-on workshop, attendees will gain a deep understanding of the importance of data preprocessing and learn essential techniques for working with real-world data.
